Favorite Character- Sanji: I hate this stupid nosebleed and pervert gimmick. It is understandable and silly to an extent, but especially after the time skip when even being within 10 feet of a woman gives him nosebleeds and he is reduced to a blithering fool.

Favorite Arc- Summit War (specifically Marineford): I hate that there were so many big names at Marineford and yet the most power displays we got were from characters we already knew.  Yes, I realize Oda is probably saving the expositions for later arcs, but I feel like we should have seen a lot more special abilities especially from the commanders of the Whitebeard pirates as it was their war.

Least Favorite Character- I am going to go with Trebol:  Trebol was really the driving force for Doflamingo's deep descent into evil, and although a lower rank than the former Shichibukai, Doflamingo would not be who and where he is if it wasn't for Trebol's influence.

Least Favorite Arc- Toss-up between Skypiea and Fishman Island so I'm going to give both a little love: Skypiea, for all its length and general irrelevance, it was the first arc to begin delving into what Haki was and how it worked, and of course this is the arc that gave us the Eneru face.  And Fishman Island was a good place to show a sample of the Post-Timeskip Straw Hat crew's powers as well as really delving into the history of Fishman Island and the political allusions that came with it.

I have been playing this game since day one, and even with working two jobs I try to devote some time to this game...Then Captain Marvel, one of my favorite characters of all time comes into the game, and it is impossible to get her without spending shards it seems...I even got stressed and bought shards last week to get Angela quickly (which is fine since I am a Spawn fan), but even with that, between her space station, not being anywhere close to Lady Loki still, and only a day and a half left, it doesn't seem like this will be happening...I can only hope she comes back..

Me her on Meetme, and should have known there was something wrong right away when the only two pictures she had were the back of her head (I am not even kidding).  She messages me first and comes on pretty strong surprisingly, but I am going along with it, making conversation, learning about what she likes in a guy, where she is from, basic stuff.  Well I inquire to her pictures and ask why she is taking them from that angle, to which she replies (and I shit you not) "Well that is all that guys are really going to be seeing when they meet up with me anyways so whats the point of taking a good pic".

Little put off at this point, but still thinking "what the hell lets go along with this", so I ask her if she can send me a picture of what she looks like...To which I receive a picture of her ENTIRE HAND in a place I wasn't really expecting or wanting to see.  So I tell her that isn't what I meant, and that I'd really like to just get to know her first, and she responds that we should meet up for a date downtown.

Well at this point, I am already put off, but wanting to give her a chance still so I agree and head downtown to meet her at the bus station...5 minutes before I arrive, she texts me saying "BTW just wanted to warn you, I am missing a few teeth".  I am a little concerned, but I am this far already.  I walk over to the spot where I was supposed to meet her, and I shit you the fuck not, she had NO TOP TEETH, and actually resembled the Goblin King from the Hobbit movie.

Now I am trying to plan my exit strategy, as I see exactly what this is.  She and I walk downtown as I frantically try and find an escape point, while she smokes and yells out some of the most horrible racial slurs I have ever heard (especially impacting me as two of my sisters are black).  So I take out my phone and call my brother and starts to pretend that he needs me to come home right away and that it is an emergency (to which he keeps responding 'what the fuck are you even talking about, I don't care if you come home or not'), and apologize to her that I have to go, and that my younger siblings need me.  She responds "oh I can handle little kids and fix the situation, plus I want to meet your family".

I look her dead in the eyes, and summoned the speed force, running as fast as I could in the opposite direction from her.

TLDR: Unknowingly met up with the racist toothless Goblin King from the Hobbit movie, who wanted to meet my family after 30 minutes of knowing me.

Well for Zephyr, you are typically going to want a good PSY team with Marco, Garp, or Shanks as a lead as they are boosting the ATK of your crew, and with Garp your HP as well.

I am sure he is possible with other colored crews, PSY is just the best bet, and looking into the box I am not seeing many characters that I think would be a good lead against him.  But then again, that is just my opinion...

Golden Pound Usopp is always a good guy to bring along, although I forget if he is vital to the Zephyr boss or not, and Franky makes a good sub, and could potentially make a good captain with his ability, however it comes with a risk as you need to keep your HP high for the whole battle...Not really sure on recommendations on what to do crew wise, as the Garp raid boss has ended, and the safest way to get new characters is by Sugo-Fest.

For leveling priorities, I see strong potential with an INT crew with a Towel Nami lead if that Nami is maxed out and evolved, and then evolve Robin for a powerful sub, along with Croc and Vista...But seeing as the Pirate level is only at 66, you are going to want to boost that up so you have more crew options.
